title: Intermediate coefficient-linear trace data
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring with identity, let $f:Y\to X$ be a finite étale morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $G$ be a sheaf of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on the small étale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $d\in\mathbf N$ and suppose that for every separably closed field $\Omega$ and every $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$, the set of lifts of $s$ to $Y$, namely the geometric fibre [def-weil-pbc-geometric-fibre], has cardinality $d$. With inverse image, direct image and the unit $\eta_G:G\to f_*f^*G$ as in [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image], there exists an $R$-linear sheaf morphism $t:f_*f^*G\to G$ such that $t\circ\eta_G=(d\cdot1_R)\operatorname{id}_G$. No invertibility of $d\cdot1_R$ is assumed. The conclusion is packaged together with a trivial inhabited marker.

source.place: Section 03SH (section-trace-method), Definition 03SE (definition-trace-map), its localization and sum characterization and the following restriction/trace degree formula; local splitting: Etale Morphisms Lemma 04HN

proof.text: Choose the counit of lowerStarUpperStarAdjunctionOfIsFinite in ModuleCat as the coefficient-linear trace. The source reverse adjunction is constructed using extension by zero and the finite-etale shriek-to-star isomorphism.

At an algebraically closed geometric point s and each lift t, compose the stalk of the ordinary unit with stalkRestrict. Rewrite the latter as the stalk of the ordinary counit through the pullback stalk comparison. Naturality of that comparison and the ordinary left triangle show that the result is the inverse stalk comparison. This proves private unit_stalk_component.

By finiteEtaleUnit_stalk_inclusion the reverse unit induces the inclusion j_t of the corresponding stalk summand. Compose with the stalk of the reverse counit, use naturality of the pullback comparison and the reverse right triangle. The result is the hom of the pullback stalk comparison. This proves private trace_stalk_component.

Write rho_t=stalkRestrict and j_t=sheafFiberToLowerStar. The finite pushforward stalk formula says Pi.lift rho is an isomorphism. Cancel this monomorphism to verify sum_t rho_t followed by j_t = identity, checking each projection. Extension by zero restricts to identity at its own point and zero at every different point, so the sum has exactly one nonzero term on each projection. Distribute the stalk of restriction followed by trace across this resolution. Steps 2 and 3 make each term the identity, including the transports along t followed by f=s.

The sum of these identities is Nat.card of the finite geometric fibre times the identity. Apply hdeg, then Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul to obtain (d:R) times the identity. The stalk functor respects scalar multiplication by the proved sheafFiber_map_smul. This includes empty sums.

Apply Scheme.sheafHom_ext_of_sheafFiber_map_algClosurePoint, from the conservative universe-lifted family of geometric points, to conclude equality of the sheaf morphisms. The preceding calculation applies to the algebraic closure of every residue field. Supply PUnit.unit for the inhabited marker. On an empty base there are no stalk comparisons to check.

from.place: Proof, first sentence: the finite étale trace composed with the adjunction unit is multiplication by the prescribed geometric-fibre degree d.

lean.statement: theorem finiteEtaleModuleTraceData {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (R : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] [Etale f] (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)) (d : ℕ) (hdeg : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X), Nat.card (f.GeometricFiber s) = d) : (∃ t : (f)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} R].obj ((f)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} R].obj G) ⟶ G, (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) f).unit.app G ≫ t = (d : R) • 𝟙 G) ∧ Nonempty PUnit.{0}
